ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity pixels (white) and 25% low-intensity pixels (black/dark-gray) concentrated in the central-basal region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region forms a symmetrical 'Y' or 'butterfly' shape anchored at the peduncle and extending along the inner margin of both lobes. The distal 2/3 of both lobes are predominantly high-intensity white, with scattered dark pixel clusters and linear streaks concentrated on the left lobe (medial-to-distal section).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree internal angle, characterized by high-contrast black pixel boundaries against the background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire horizontal boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from fine-grain jaggedness to deeper sub-notches, particularly prominent on the inner trailing margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary trailing edge, transitioning to a sharp, tapered lateral point (tips) on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast textured clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, exhibiting high structural relief against the smoother fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical dark linear streaks on the medial region of the left lobe, and multiple diagonal/horizontal linear disruptions on the distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and small-scale chipping across the trailing edge topography; cluster of white calcified growths (barnacles) at the lateral lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Single, isolated dark circular focal point (approximate diameter 15-20 pixels) located in the lower-central high-intensity white field of the left lobe.
